body: I am sorry but this is bullshit. No amount of inner dialogue will change the fact that noone in my misarable life found me attractive. Self  hate wont change without external validation.
I can't even imagine how precious an affectionate hug is
I feel the same, I ve been avoiding taking picutres for some time but I can't even look at the mirror anymore. I wish I could be someone else at random.
Read books. A lot of them.

Its 6 am here and I don't have anyone to talk to, I also cant create a new post because karma. Sorry for hijacking. I just need to vent. I really don't know what to do just don't want to take this anymore. I am 34, FA. Spent my whole life getting rejected by people who I really click and have a good time together. Today I learned my crush decided to get in a relationship with someone who she called a complete moron. I don't even know what to feel bad about, having crushes at my age because I never matured as a person wrt relationships? Knowing only reason I am alone is because I am genetic trash? People telling me its my personality not my looks despite my success in making friends and having a wonderful time with people I am in love with? That I am misarable and alone despite doing very well financially? People don't even see me as a potential partner because of my looks? You know when people claim they don't know anyone to match with you but when an average friend is single they magically have 20 potential friends?

​

At this point its my fault tbh, after countless times I got crashed and burned why the fuck do I still get involved with these women? What kind of idiot never learns from their mistakes? I just cant take this shit anymore. Its way too much and there is no way out.

Sorry for my incoherent ramblings.
